## Updated evaluation guide

The Evaluate Zep for Your Use Case guide was rewritten to match the current
evaluation workflow, covering test-case design, user and document ingestion,
scoped versus automatic search, and graph inspection for debugging.

Read the docs

## Retry a failed member search when adding users to a group

The Add users picker now shows a Retry control when the candidate user list
fails to load. Previously a failed load left no visible way to try again
without reopening the dialog.
